notes: V7.1.13: Phase D of Step 5 — per-bot 'Run on Oracle 24/7' toggles in Tools → AUTOMATION. Tick a bot's cloud box and ▶ on its tab calls the APEX server instead of spawning a local subprocess. Cloud-running bots poll status + log tail every 30 s so the panel stays live. When a bot is both ticked for cloud AND ticked for auto-schedule, the server-side scheduler manages it via the US market clock. Plus chart fix: portfolio graphs no longer shrink to 13:30-20:00 UTC. NaN equity samples outside market hours are now forward-filled with the last known value so the X-axis spans the full requested period (flat line overnight).
